title: Kth largest
statementMd:
Return the k-th largest element (1-based, counting duplicates) of the list.

**Example:** `kth_largest([3, 2, 1, 5, 6, 4], 2)` returns `5`.
solutionMd:
```python
def kth_largest(nums, k):
    return sorted(nums, reverse=True)[k - 1]
```

Sorting is O(n log n) and simple.
